lines.en: label yasusummer2chapelgen:
scene yasusummer2chapelgen
I wind up at the cathedral without any recollection of actually coming here.
lines.zh: 我最后到了大教堂，却完全想不起自己是怎么来的。

lines.en: It feels a lot different inside than it did during Winter, but I imagine it’s due to the fact that this building is likely hundreds of years old and that there haven’t been many upgrades made to it within that time.
lines.zh: 里面的感觉跟冬天时大不一样，不过我想那是因为这栋建筑大概有几百年的历史，而这段时间里没怎么翻修过。

lines.en: I approach Yasu and hear her mumbling something to herself, but I’m unable to decipher any of the words.
lines.zh: 我走近 Yasu，听见她在自己嘀咕什么，可我一个字都听不出来。

lines.en: It sounds almost as if she’s speaking backwards.
lines.zh: 听起来几乎像是她在倒着说话。

lines.en: I’m sure it’s just her being weird though.
lines.zh: 不过我敢肯定那只是她在犯怪。

lines.en: She tends to do that a lot, especially within what’s left of these walls.
lines.zh: 她经常这样，尤其是在这堵墙剩下的这些部分之内。

lines.en: I attempt to snap her out of her delusions or...visions or...whatever sort of false states of mind someone’s god can force them into, but make no progress at all.
lines.zh: 我试着把她从那些妄想、或者……异象、或者……随便什么她那个神能把人塞进去的虚假精神状态里拽出来，可一点进展都没有。

lines.en: scene black
It isn’t until she’s finished praying that I’m able to talk to her. But even then, the residual effects of fraudulent divinity contaminate the conversation and make it hard for me to focus.
lines.zh: 直到她祈祷完，我才能跟她说话。可即便到那时，那股伪神性的残余还在污染这场对话，让我很难集中。

lines.en: I understand that if I ever want to be with Yasu and not this shell of a human being possessed by a spirit that I must do so away from this place.
lines.zh: 我明白：如果我想跟 Yasu 在一起，而不是跟这具被灵附了身的人类躯壳在一起，我就必须离这地方远点。

lines.en: And yet I find myself here time and time again, hoping that things will be different when they never are.
lines.zh: 可我还是一次一次地跑到这儿来，盼着事情会不一样——而它从来没不一样过。

lines.en: I leave and incur the wrath of whoever it is she believes in.
lines.zh: 我离开了，也因此招来了她所信的那位的怒火。

lines.en: But her love for me grows because I managed to show up- and that’s more than most people can say.
lines.zh: 但她对我的爱增长了，因为我毕竟露面了——而这已经比大多数人能说的要多了。

Yasu’s affection has increased to [yasu_love]!
lines.zh: Yasu 的好感度提升到了 [yasu_love]！
